title: Wrong-person first-failure leg is a read-then-update: the generic update_reference_call_status guard lacks the atomic `taken_over_at IS NULL` check its webhook sibling mark_awaiting_correction has
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1235: 'case row.taken_over_at != "" {' -> 'False ->' ... 'sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)'; update_reference_call_status.sql:23-24: 'WHERE id = $1\n  AND status = $5::reference_call_status' (no taken_over_at); contrast mark_awaiting_correction.sql:23: 'AND taken_over_at IS NULL'
detail: A take-over landing between get_form_context_by_form_token's read and the wrong-person UPDATE still yanks a landlord-handled row into awaiting_correction (status guard passes; taken_over_at is only read, never re-checked atomically). Take-over set excludes awaiting_correction, so the landlord cannot re-take; must correct.
recommended_fix: Add `AND taken_over_at IS NULL` to the update_reference_call_status.sql WHERE (or scope the wrong-person transition to a dedicated query mirroring mark_awaiting_correction.sql), matching the atomic guard the webhook leg already has.
